reply.text:
I'm sorry your back is giving you trouble. A back that's cranky is one for a doctor or physio to look at, not me, so I won't assess it or tell you what it means.

What I can do is take the barbell hip thrusts out of your program. Tell me which session they sit in and I'll make that change for you, and I'll keep the rest of the training moving around it. Anything else you want me to avoid while it settles, just say so and I'll build around it.
